tests.scope: CPU dispatch/profiler gates and CUDA helper tests on SM86. Dual-query probe models group completion with a subgroup barrier, then exercises the production named-barrier handoff; no TMA/WGMMA execution.

sm90a_cross_compile.scope: Static instruction text comparison excludes encodings/control words, execution and hardware counters; remote CUDA 13 may differ.

h200_validation: Not run locally. Remote build script runs 352 new dtype/dim/shape/algorithm/mode cases, 3 repetitions each; 16 uniform-attention answers with nonzero V padding; 32 HND/NHD public API checks on a nondefault stream.
h200_performance: Unmeasured. Compare same-run full API against vc22_both and original Sage; no 22 ms claim.
